needed.evidence: Visible piles of goods, no usable footway; people and vehicles mixing
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, dedicated sidewalk along the left side of the road to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: Obstructions with parked auto-rickshaws and informal paths, no usable footway
needed.suggestion: Clear the right-side informal path of obstructions and create a physically separated sidewalk at least 1 meter wide.

needed.evidence: Areas of high pedestrian activity without purpose-built crossings, pedestrians crossing in roadway
needed.suggestion: Install marked zebra crossings at key points, accompanied by kerb ramps, to provide safe pedestrian crossings where people currently traverse the carriageway.

needed.evidence: Urban area with limited visible street lighting
needed.suggestion: Install additional streetlights to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers, especially in darker sections of the sidewalk.
